caption: The drawing depicts a wooden spinning wheel, rendered in shades of brown, with detailed line work and shading to indicate texture and form. The spinning wheel is composed of several parts, including a large circular wheel on the right, which has multiple spokes radiating from a central hub and is attached to a rectangular horizontal platform supported by three turned legs, one of which connects diagonally via a crossbar. On top of the platform, a whorl, spindle, and flyer are visible. To the left, there is a vertical distaff holding a mass of off-white or light tan fiber or wool, wrapped around the top spindle. The entire object is centered within a double-lined rectangular border drawn in a muted red-brown tone on cream-colored paper. Near the lower right border inside the frame, the name "LORENZ ROTHKRANZ" is printed in capital letters.
title: Spinning Wheel
